title: Part 4 Practice: Factors Affecting Population Distribution and Socio-cultural Aspects

questions.text: The diagram below shows factors affecting population distribution. Which of the following is a PHYSICAL factor?

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <text x="80" y="20" fill="#facc15" font-size="8">Factors Affecting Population Distribution</text>
                    <rect x="15" y="30" width="85" height="90" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="30" y="48" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Physical</text>
                    <text x="25" y="63" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Climate</text>
                    <text x="25" y="76" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Soil</text>
                    <text x="25" y="89" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Topography</text>
                    <text x="25" y="102" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Water</text>
                    <text x="25" y="115" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Altitude</text>
                    <rect x="110" y="30" width="85" height="90" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#14b8a6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="125" y="48" fill="#14b8a6" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Human</text>
                    <text x="120" y="63" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Infrastructure</text>
                    <text x="120" y="76" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Employment</text>
                    <text x="120" y="89" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Education</text>
                    <text x="120" y="102" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Culture</text>
                    <text x="120" y="115" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Politics</text>
                    <rect x="205" y="30" width="85" height="90" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="220" y="48" fill="#f59e0b" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Economic</text>
                    <text x="215" y="63" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Agriculture</text>
                    <text x="215" y="76" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Trade</text>
                    <text x="215" y="89" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Industry</text>
                    <text x="215" y="102" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="6">• Services</text>
                </svg>

questions.explanation: Correct: Climate and soil are physical factors. A is wrong—infrastructure is a human factor. B is wrong—employment is a human factor. D is wrong—cultural ties and politics are human factors.

questions.text: According to the diagram, approximately what percentage of Ethiopia's population lives in the highlands?

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <text x="80" y="20" fill="#facc15" font-size="8">Population Distribution in Ethiopia</text>
                    <rect x="20" y="30" width="150" height="80" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#14b8a6" stroke-width="2"/>
                    <text x="50" y="50" fill="#14b8a6" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Highlands</text>
                    <text x="35" y="65" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• 40% of land area</text>
                    <text x="35" y="80" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• 80-85% of population</text>
                    <text x="35" y="95" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">• Favorable climate</text>
                    <rect x="180" y="30" width="100" height="80" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f43f5e" stroke-width="2"/>
                    <text x="195" y="50" fill="#f43f5e" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Lowlands</text>
                    <text x="190" y="65" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• 60% of land area</text>
                    <text x="190" y="80" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• 15-20% of pop.</text>
                    <text x="190" y="95" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">• Arid climate</text>
                </svg>

questions.explanation: Correct: About 80-85% of the population lives in the highlands. A is wrong—too low. B is wrong—too low. D is wrong—too high.

questions.text: The diagram below shows progress in health since 1990. How much has infant mortality declined?

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <text x="80" y="20" fill="#facc15" font-size="8">Health Progress Since 1990</text>
                    <rect x="20" y="30" width="250" height="40" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#14b8a6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="35" y="45" fill="#14b8a6" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Infant Mortality</text>
                    <text x="35" y="58" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">1990: 115/1,000 → 2023: 43/1,000</text>
                    <rect x="20" y="75" width="250" height="40" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f43f5e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="35" y="90" fill="#f43f5e" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Maternal Mortality</text>
                    <text x="35" y="103" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">1990: 1,050/100,000 → 2023: 267/100,000</text>
                    <text x="30" y="138" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">Significant progress but challenges remain</text>
                </svg>

questions.explanation: Correct: 115 - 43 = 72 per 1,000 decline. A is wrong—too low. C is wrong—too high. D is wrong—too high.

questions.text: The Health Extension Program diagram shows one of Ethiopia's most successful health initiatives. What is its primary focus?

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <text x="80" y="20" fill="#facc15" font-size="8">Health Extension Program</text>
                    <rect x="20" y="30" width="260" height="35" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#14b8a6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="35" y="45" fill="#14b8a6" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Community-Based Healthcare</text>
                    <text x="35" y="58" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">Over 40,000 health extension workers</text>
                    <rect x="20" y="70" width="260" height="35" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f43f5e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="35" y="85" fill="#f43f5e" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Key Services</text>
                    <text x="35" y="98" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">Immunization, Family Planning, Maternal Health, Nutrition, Sanitation</text>
                    <text x="30" y="135" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">Launched 2003 - Transformed rural healthcare delivery</text>
                </svg>

options: A) Building large hospitals in cities
B) Community-based healthcare in rural areas
questions.correct_answer: B) Community-based healthcare in rural areas
questions.explanation: Correct: HEP focuses on community-based healthcare in rural areas. A is wrong—it focuses on primary healthcare, not large hospitals. C is wrong—this is not the primary focus. D is wrong—it trains health extension workers, not just doctors.

questions.text: The diagram shows population distribution patterns. Which factor explains why the highlands have higher population density?

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <text x="80" y="20" fill="#facc15" font-size="8">Population Distribution in Ethiopia</text>
                    <rect x="20" y="30" width="150" height="80" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#14b8a6" stroke-width="2"/>
                    <text x="50" y="50" fill="#14b8a6" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Highlands</text>
                    <text x="35" y="65" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• 40% of land area</text>
                    <text x="35" y="80" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• 80-85% of population</text>
                    <text x="35" y="95" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• High density</text>
                    <rect x="180" y="30" width="100" height="80" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f43f5e" stroke-width="2"/>
                    <text x="195" y="50" fill="#f43f5e" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Lowlands</text>
                    <text x="190" y="65" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• 60% of land area</text>
                    <text x="190" y="80" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• 15-20% of pop.</text>
                    <text x="190" y="95" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">• Low density</text>
                    <text x="30" y="135" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">Highlands: Favorable climate, fertile soils, better water availability</text>
                </svg>

options: A) Favorable climate, fertile soils, and reliable water
questions.correct_answer: A) Favorable climate, fertile soils, and reliable water
questions.explanation: Correct: Physical factors explain highland concentration. B is wrong—policies are not the primary reason. C is wrong—historical patterns are part of it but not the only reason. D is wrong—birth rates are not significantly different.

questions.text: The diagram shows progress in education and health. What is the relationship between women's education and fertility in Ethiopia?

diagram.content:
<svg width="300" height="150" viewBox="0 0 300 150">
                    <rect width="300" height="150" fill="#111827" rx="8"/>
                    <text x="80" y="20" fill="#facc15" font-size="8">Education and Health Progress</text>
                    <rect x="20" y="30" width="260" height="35" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#14b8a6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="35" y="45" fill="#14b8a6" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Education Progress</text>
                    <text x="35" y="58" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">Literacy: 20% (1990) → 52% (2023)</text>
                    <rect x="20" y="70" width="260" height="35" rx="4" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#f43f5e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
                    <text x="35" y="85" fill="#f43f5e" font-size="7" font-weight="bold">Health Progress</text>
                    <text x="35" y="98" fill="#f8fafc" font-size="7">Life Expectancy: 45 yrs (1990) → 65-68 yrs (2023)</text>
                    <text x="30" y="135" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="7">Women's education lowers fertility and improves health outcomes</text>
                </svg>

options: A) Higher education leads to higher fertility
B) Higher education leads to lower fertility
D) Education only affects health, not fertility
questions.correct_answer: B) Higher education leads to lower fertility
questions.explanation: Correct: Educated women tend to have fewer children. A is wrong—education reduces fertility. C is wrong—there is a clear relationship. D is wrong—education affects both health and fertility.
